transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1540 White Hart Run?
Yes, this is 1540 White Hart Run. We’re safe, three people here, no water inside, and no one needs to be left alone.
Thank you for confirming your safety and details. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Three people are here. No one can’t come to the phone.

Got it, three people here, all can come to the phone. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one can’t leave alone. No wheelchairs or oxygen needed.
Understood, no one needs assistance leaving. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside. Everyone’s safe and fine.
Thanks for letting us know everyone is safe. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No truck, no boat, no free seats.
Got it, no truck, no boat, no free seats. Let me read that back: 3 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yes. Three people. No water inside.
Thank you for confirming the details. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
